public_body: Berlin-Boylston Regional School District School Committee
overall: The AG found no violation: the amended May 28 notice was not required because the topic was unanticipated, and the Committee's own website was not an official posting location at the time.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee amended its May 28 meeting notice less than 48 hours before the meeting, improperly.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, although the Committee could have discussed the unanticipated topic without adding it to the meeting notice at all, the Committee attempted to follow our recommended practice of amending the meeting notice to add the topic

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the amended notice was never posted to the Berlin website, the official posting location, before the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: The Committee posted the amended notice only to its own website, but that was not an official notice posting location, and therefore we do not review the meeting notice posted there.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the amended notice posted on the Committee's website did not list the date and time it was amended.
allegations.key_passage: Although the Committee has acknowledged both points, we find no violation of the Open Meeting Law.
